1. (offensive, ethnic slur, vulgar, see usage notes) A black person; a person of black African descent.
2. (offensive, ethnic slur, vulgar, see usage notes) A member of any typically dark-skinned people (now especially in combinations like prairie nigger. or sand nigger.).
3. (AAVE) A friend, particularly a fellow black person (often as an informal term of address).
4. (figurative, especially, AAVE, otherwise, offensive) A person of any kind (particularly as a term of abuse).
5. (especially in comparisons, now, offensive) A member of a group that is oppressed or marginalized in the manner of black people.
6. (now, offensive) Any of various dark animals:
7. (archaic, electrical) An impurity in the covering of an electrical conductor which serves to make a partial short circuit, and thus becomes sufficiently heated to burn and destroy the insulation.

10. (film, dated) A black screen used in conjunction with the camera to block light or produce special lighting effects.
